info.title: AegisVision local C++ API
info.description: Local-only service, no authentication/TLS. Do not expose publicly. Host must be localhost:<port> or 127.0.0.1:<port>; Origin, if present, must equal http://Host. POST requires application/json, maximum 8192 bytes. One finite-job worker; live sessions are separate and nonpersistent. Models/features vary: inspect /api/health. Schemas describe the contract, not runtime schema enforcement. No file-upload endpoint.
